svg.title: Echo goodput and relative performance
svg.desc: Mode 2 comparison at 4, 16, and 64 KiB. Points are medians of 14 measurements; whiskers show minima and maxima, not confidence intervals. Klet/virtio ratios are 0.85, 1.32, and 1.80. Lines only connect measured sizes.
